column1: # UNGRADABLE.tsv -- fpc_tests: the lockdown bucket. MIRRORS OUTSIDE_ISO_BASELINE.tsv beside it ROW FOR ROW; the runner compares
# the two every run and says so aloud when they drift. That file is THE RECORD (with the measurement); this one keeps the
# inventory numbers summing to shipped. Edit them together. The ruling is the ORACLE's -- ISO 7185, on Lon's word "use ISO as
# oracle" (CEO-1225) -- and it stands unchanged whatever our own compiler does; our agreeing refusal is an AGREEMENT-CONTROL only.
